title: tinyprobe file
description: A tinyprobe API file (endpoints) or workflow (steps). Validate with `tinyprobe inspect`; the format is in `tinyprobe guide`.

name.description: Name of the workflow, shown in the report. Default: the file name.

description.description: What the workflow tests, shown in the report.

import.description: API files whose endpoints the steps can call, relative to this file: one path or a list.

variables.description: Default variables of the workflow, `name: value`. Each is resolved once per run and may use the environment, other variables and generated values (`${$uuid}`). The environment file overrides them.

settings.description: `timeout` (seconds per request) and `max_retries` (retries on network errors and timeouts).

steps.description: The steps, run in order. A step `call`s an endpoint or `sleep`s; the workflow stops at the first failing step.

base_url.description: Prepended to every `path` of this file, usually `${baseUrl}` from the environment file.

headers.description: Headers sent by every endpoint of this file, `Name: value`.

auth.description: Named auth sets: headers, such as `bearer: { Authorization: "Bearer ${token}" }`, and at most one of `basic` and `oauth2`. An endpoint picks them with `auth:`.

endpoints.description: The endpoints, by name. Steps call them like functions: `call: <name>`, with arguments in `with`.

path.description: Path, after the file's `base_url`; may contain placeholders, such as `/users/${id}`.

query.description: Names of the query parameters. Each one is sent only when the step passes it in `with`.

headers.description: Headers of this endpoint, `Name: value`, after the file's headers and auth sets.

auth.description: The auth set to send, or a list of them (`[bearer, apikey]`).

body.description: The request body: a YAML value sent as JSON, a string sent as is, or a single `${...}` placeholder.

form.description: An `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` body, `field: value`, encoded by tinyprobe. A list sends the field once per value. Instead of `body`.

multipart.description: A `multipart/form-data` body (file uploads), `field: value` or `field: { file: path }`. A list sends the field once per item. Instead of `body`.

params.description: The arguments of the endpoint, `name: default`, or `name:` for a required one. Steps pass them in `with`; they never come from global variables.

multipart_file.description: A file of a multipart body.

file.description: The path of the file to send, relative to the file tinyprobe was given (the workflow, or the API file of a `call`). May be a placeholder.

filename.description: The file name sent to the server. Default: the name of the file.

content_type.description: The type of the file. Default: from its extension (`.png` is `image/png`), otherwise `application/octet-stream`.

auth_set.description: An auth set: headers (`Name: value`), and at most one of `basic` and `oauth2`.

basic.description: Basic auth: `username` and `password`; tinyprobe sends `Authorization: Basic` with their base64.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 client credentials: tinyprobe gets a token from `token_url` on first use, reuses it for the run until it expires, and sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

username.description: The user name. May be a placeholder. Cannot contain `:`.

password.description: The password. May be a placeholder, e.g. `${password}` from the env file.

token_url.description: The token endpoint, a full URL such as `${authUrl}/oauth/token`.

client_secret.description: The client secret: a placeholder, with the value in `env.local.yaml`.

scope.description: Optional: a scope, or a list of scopes, sent joined with spaces.

client_auth.description: How the client id and secret are sent: `basic` (an `Authorization: Basic` header, the default) or `form` (fields of the body).

form.description: Other fields of the token request, such as `audience` (Auth0) or `resource` (Azure AD).

save_cookie.description: A value saved from a cookie.

cookie.description: The name of a cookie in the jar after the response, for the request's URL. Its value is saved.

name.description: Shown in the report. Default: the call and its path and query arguments.

call.description: The endpoint to call, by name.

with.description: Arguments of the endpoint, `name: value`. Values may use variables, such as `id: ${userId}`.

expect.description: What the response must be: `status`, `headers`, `cookies`, `body` (by JSONPath) and `duration`. Without `status`, any 2xx passes.

until.description: Polling: repeat the call until these conditions pass, every `every`, at most `timeout`. Then `expect` is checked on the last response.

save.description: Values of the response for the next steps, `variable: <JSONPath>` or `variable: { cookie: name }`, saved after every check passed.

sleep.description: A step of its own that waits, such as `500ms` or `2s`.

status.description: Expected status code, or a list of accepted ones (`[200, 204]`).

headers.description: Checks on response headers, by name (case-insensitive): a value, or conditions such as `{ exists: true }`.

cookies.description: Checks on cookies by name (case-sensitive), in the workflow's cookie jar after the response, for the request's URL: a value, or conditions such as `{ exists: false }`.

body.description: Checks on the JSON body, by JSONPath (`$.id`, `$.items[0].name`): a value, or conditions such as `{ gt: 0 }`.

duration.description: Check on the response time, such as `{ lt: 500ms }`.

status.description: Wait until the status is this code, or one of a list. Without it, any status is accepted while waiting.

headers.description: Wait until these header checks pass.

cookies.description: Wait until these cookie checks pass.

body.description: Wait until these body checks pass, by JSONPath. Stop on every final state, then check the expected one in `expect`.

timeout.description: Give up after this time. Default: 30s.

max_retries.description: Retries on network errors and timeouts. HTTP error statuses are never retried. Default: 0.

condition.description: Conditions on a value; all must pass.

gt.description: Greater than this number, or this duration in `expect.duration`.

lt.description: Less than this number, or this duration in `expect.duration`.

exists.description: `true`: the value is present; `false`: it is not.

contains.description: A string contains this text, or a list contains this item.

any.description: One of these conditions passes (OR), such as `[{ lt: 0 }, { gt: 100 }]`.

duration_condition.description: Conditions on the response time, with durations such as `500ms`.

gt.description: Greater than this number, or this duration in `expect.duration`.

lt.description: Less than this number, or this duration in `expect.duration`.

check.description: A value (equal to it), or conditions such as `{ gt: 0, lt: 10 }`.
